Artist Overview

At eighteen, Mary balances a scholarship, library work, family life, and an earnest fascination with monster folklore. Bloodlines follows what she notices, believes, doubts, and sings; rumor and scholarship remain evidence, not automatic proof.

“Welcome to Ridgefall, where nothing really happens.”
